title: Unreal Engine/C++ Developer
description: Your new company Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters. Your new role We are seeking an experienced VR Training Devices Developer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing advanced training devices for customers operating the Gripen fighter. These devices leverage virtual reality (VR) environments to provide immersive and resource-effective training for both flight and maintenance procedures. As part of a VR-development team your main objectives will be: Develop and optimize interactive VR experiences using principles and technology from the gaming industry. Create training devices that enhance operator skills in a safe and efficient manner. Improve the performance and maintainability of the SCT tool. Collaborate with business stakeholders to rework the data model and transition to a new framework and development environment. Develop a cloud-based application using .Net Blazor to support efficient maintenance operations for various aircraft and base configurations. What you'll need to succeed You will bring a robust set of technical skills and qualifications to this role. With a solid foundation in C++ and Unreal Engine, you will be comfortable navigating the complexities of VR development. Your experience with XR technologies, particularly VR, will be crucial in creating immersive training environments. You should be adept at working in the early phases of development, including concept development and prototyping, ensuring that our training devices are innovative and effective from the outset. Your expertise in software architecture and design patterns will be invaluable in building scalable and maintainable solutions. Proficiency in Git and experience with version control systems such as Bitbucket, Artifactory, or Azure DevOps will enable you to manage code efficiently and collaborate seamlessly with your team. A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field will provide the academic background necessary for this role. Additionally, a proven track record in developing VR applications, possibly in a defence or aerospace context, will demonstrate your ability to deliver high-quality solutions in a specialised field. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail are essential, as is the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, will ensure that you can effectively convey your ideas and collaborate with colleagues across different disciplines. title: 3D Artist
description: 3D Artist We are seeking an experienced 3D Artist to join our dynamic VR development team. In this role, you will play a key part in creating high-quality 3D assets and environments for advanced training devices used by customers operating the Gripen fighter. These devices leverage virtual reality (VR) to deliver immersive, cost-effective, and safe training solutions for both flight and maintenance operations. Your role As part of a VR development team, your main objectives will be to create visually compelling and technically optimized 3D content that supports realistic and effective training experiences. Key tasks: • Create, optimize, and maintain high-quality 3D models, textures, and materials for VR training environments. • Develop realistic assets such as aircraft components, tools, environments, and props with a strong focus on accuracy and usability. • Ensure assets meet performance requirements for real-time VR applications. • Work closely with developers, designers, and subject matter experts to ensure correct functionality and visual fidelity. • Integrate assets into Unreal Engine and collaborate on lighting, shaders, and scene composition. • Participate in concept development, visual prototyping, and iterative improvement of training scenarios. • Follow established pipelines and contribute to improving workflows and asset standards. Your profile You bring a strong artistic and technical skill set suited for real-time 3D production in VR environments. With solid experience in 3D content creation for games, simulations, or XR applications, you are comfortable working from early concepts through to finalized, optimized assets ready for deployment. You have proven proficiency in industry-standard 3D tools such as Maya, Blender, 3ds Max, ZBrush, and Substance Painter/Designer, and experience working with physically based rendering (PBR) workflows. Familiarity with Unreal Engine and real-time asset integration is essential, as is an understanding of performance constraints specific to VR. Basic knowledge of animation, rigging and skinning is also preferrable. Experience working in early development phases, including concept development and prototyping, will allow you to contribute creatively and practically to new training solutions. An eye for detail, accuracy, and realism—particularly when working with technical or mechanical subjects—will be highly valued. You are accustomed to working in collaborative, cross-functional teams and are comfortable using version control systems such as Git and Perforce. A Bachelor’s degree in 3D Art, Game Art, Computer Graphics, or a related field is desirable, along with a portfolio demonstrating high-quality real-time 3D work. Experience in defence, aerospace, or simulation projects is considered a strong advantage. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to take feedback constructively are essential. You communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues from different technical and creative disciplines. This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply. What you will be part of Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

title: 3D Artist
description: 3D Artist We are seeking an experienced 3D Artist to join our dynamic VR development team. In this role, you will play a key part in creating high-quality 3D assets and environments for advanced training devices used by customers operating the Gripen fighter. These devices leverage virtual reality (VR) to deliver immersive, cost-effective, and safe training solutions for both flight and maintenance operations. Your role As part of a VR development team, your main objectives will be to create visually compelling and technically optimized 3D content that supports realistic and effective training experiences. Key tasks: • Create, optimize, and maintain high-quality 3D models, textures, and materials for VR training environments. • Develop realistic assets such as aircraft components, tools, environments, and props with a strong focus on accuracy and usability. • Ensure assets meet performance requirements for real-time VR applications. • Work closely with developers, designers, and subject matter experts to ensure correct functionality and visual fidelity. • Integrate assets into Unreal Engine and collaborate on lighting, shaders, and scene composition. • Participate in concept development, visual prototyping, and iterative improvement of training scenarios. • Follow established pipelines and contribute to improving workflows and asset standards. Your profile You bring a strong artistic and technical skill set suited for real-time 3D production in VR environments. With solid experience in 3D content creation for games, simulations, or XR applications, you are comfortable working from early concepts through to finalized, optimized assets ready for deployment. You have proven proficiency in industry-standard 3D tools such as Maya, Blender, 3ds Max, ZBrush, and Substance Painter/Designer, and experience working with physically based rendering (PBR) workflows. Familiarity with Unreal Engine and real-time asset integration is essential, as is an understanding of performance constraints specific to VR. Basic knowledge of animation, rigging and skinning is also preferrable. Experience working in early development phases, including concept development and prototyping, will allow you to contribute creatively and practically to new training solutions. An eye for detail, accuracy, and realism—particularly when working with technical or mechanical subjects—will be highly valued. You are accustomed to working in collaborative, cross-functional teams and are comfortable using version control systems such as Git and Perforce. A Bachelor’s degree in 3D Art, Game Art, Computer Graphics, or a related field is desirable, along with a portfolio demonstrating high-quality real-time 3D work. Experience in defence, aerospace, or simulation projects is considered a strong advantage. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to take feedback constructively are essential. You communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues from different technical and creative disciplines. This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply. What you will be part of Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

description: Software Tester (QA) – VR Training Devices We are seeking an experienced Software Tester (QA) to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of advanced training devices used by customers operating the Gripen fighter. These devices leverage virtual reality (VR) environments to provide immersive and resource-effective training for both flight and maintenance procedures.Want to influence the bigger picture? Experience in both manual and automated testing is valuable, and knowledge of scripting or programming (e.g., Python, C++, or similar) is considered a plus. You are comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams throughout all phases of development, from early prototypes to final delivery. A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is desirable. Experience in regulated or high-reliability environments such as defence, aerospace, or simulation will be an advantage. You are detail-oriented, analytical, and persistent in identifying issues and ensuring high-quality outcomes. Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal, enable you to clearly report findings and collaborate effectively with team members across disciplines. This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance, additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
